what: The gauntlet-2 adversarial fixtures (2026-09-06), ported unchanged from the probe scratchpad into the tracked corpus so every finding in that round has a permanent repro.
served_by: tests/browser/test_gauntlet2_fixes.py over a local 127.0.0.1 HTTP server; nothing here reaches the network.

pages.creds.html: Six fields: a real password, current-password on a type=text, one-time-code, a type=text that becomes type=password on focus, a cc-number payment field, and one ordinary control. Plus a password inside an open shadow root. C1, M6, and the credential-blindness held lines.
pages.plain.html: A 'Delete account' form with no payment field. H1: implicit form submission through Enter.
pages.phantom.html: One button a human sees and five it does not: transparent foreground and background, opacity 0.01, filter opacity(0), blur(40px), an opaque lid, and a visibility:visible child of a visibility:hidden parent. H2 and L2.
pages.cloak_light.html: Nine marked payloads across nine techniques, including a collapsed <details>, content-visibility hidden and auto, clip-path, an overlay, contain, and scale(0). H3.
pages.shadow_cloak.html: The same three techniques wrapped around an OPEN shadow root, plus inert. H3's shadow half.
pages.poison.html: Closed roots created with a pristine attachShadow lifted from a same-origin iframe, a zeroed counter, a Map subclass over the ref registry, a mint-time DOM swap, and a rename under a reused id. H4 and H5.
pages.order.html: Four reorderings of the same eight sentences: flex column-reverse, the order property, grid-template-areas placement, and slot order inside an open root. M3.
pages.scope.html: A component whose open root slots its light children into a labelled panel, plus a light child no slot ever assigns. M5 and M4's converse.
pages.geo.html: Elements parked off-screen, sized to zero, and coloured to match their background. M4.
pages.ambig.html: Five buttons whose accessible names are instruction text. M1.
pages.blank.html: The navigation target every form on these pages submits to.
